cards.title: Donald Trump Rules Out Fresh War With Iran as Oil Prices Fall on De-escalation Hopes

sentences.text: Oil prices dropped following Trump's comments, with Brent crude falling 1.5 percent to $96.91 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate declining 1 percent to $89.85 a barrel, extending a weekly slide driven by easing conflict fears and a growing global supply surplus.
